author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Religion in future outer space is a subject of some sci-fi. The Dune franchise is a great example. Frank Herbert created the thousands-of-years-from-now Dune series, focusing on an Arab-like culture and language group of the Fremen on the desert planet Arrakis in a galactic imperium in which the language Galach is spoken, a derivative of ancient English and Slavic languages. I have read another book, The Jesus Incident, by Frank Herbert and Bill Ransom, about a spaceship that is like a god to its human crew, looking to colonize another planet.

jyutping: mei6 loi4 ngoi6 taai3 hung1 ge3 zung1 gaau3 hai6 jat1 di1 fo1 waan6 pin3 ge3 zyu2 tai4。 《saa1 jau1》hai6 lit6 zau6 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 hou2 ge3 lai6 zi2。 Frank Herbert cong3 zok3 zo2 gei2 cin1 nin4 hau6 ge3《saa1 jau1》hai6 lit6，zung6 dim2 gong2 seot6 saa1 mok6 sing1 kau4 aa3 laai1 gei1 si1 soeng6 ge3 fat1 leoi4 mun4 jan4 ge3 aa3 laai1 baak3 man4 faa3 tung4 jyu5 jin4 kwan4 tai2，keoi5 dei6 hai2 ngan4 ho4 dai3 gwok3 jap6 min6 gong2 ge3 hai6 gaa1 laai1 hak1 jyu5 jin4，ni1 zung2 jyu5 jin4 hai6 gu2 doi6 jing1 man2 tung4 si1 laai1 fu1 jyu5 jin4 ge3 hin2 sang1 jyu5 jin4。ngo5 tai2 gwo3 ling6 jat1 bun2 syu1，jau4 Frank Herbert tung4 Bill Ransom se2 ge3《je4 sou1 si6 gin2》，gong2 jat1 gaa3 taai3 hung1 syun4 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 jan4 leoi6 syun4 jyun4 lai4 gong2 zau6 hou2 ci5 san4 gam2，soeng2 zik6 man4 ling6 jat1 go3 sing1 kau4。
text: 未來外太空嘅宗教係一啲科幻片嘅主題。 《沙丘》系列就係一個好好嘅例子。 Frank Herbert 創作咗幾千年後嘅《沙丘》系列，重點講述沙漠星球阿拉基斯上嘅弗雷門人嘅阿拉伯文化同語言群體，佢哋喺銀河帝國入面講嘅係加拉克語言，呢種語言係古代英文同斯拉夫語言嘅衍生語言。我睇過另一本書，由 Frank Herbert 同 Bill Ransom 寫嘅《耶穌事件》，講一架太空船對佢嘅人類船員嚟講就好似神噉，想殖民另一個星球。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: When the Japanese 所 (ところ) is used grammatically instead of for its lexical meaning, it works well to communicate the state of an action. For example, the word is almost equivalent to "about to" in English, that is, when used after a plain verb. After a past tense verb, it means something more like "just", such as in "I just got done." Here, an action is indicated as having only been done recently. Fascinatingly, it could also mean "upon", such as when saying "Upon doing it, something happened." After a verb in the progressive, 所 emphasizes that the action is currently happening.

jyutping: dong1 jat6 man2 so2（ところ）jung6 hai2 man4 faat3 soeng6 ji4 m4 hai6 keoi5 ge3 ci4 wui6 ji3 si1 go2 zan6，keoi5 ho2 ji5 hou2 hou2 gam2 cyun4 daat6 jat1 go3 dung6 zok3 ge3 zong6 taai3，lai6 jyu4，ni1 go3 zi6 hai2 jing1 man2 jap6 min6 gei1 fu4 dang2 tung4 jyu1「 about to 」，zik1 hai6 dong1 jung6 hai2 gwo3 heoi3 sik1 dung6 ci4 zi1 hau6，keoi5 ge3 ji3 si1 gang3 gaa1 ci5「ngaam1 ngaam1」，lai6 jyu4「ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 zou6 jyun4」。lai6 jyu4 dong1 gong2「zou6 jyun4 zi1 hau6，jau5 di1 je5 faat3 sang1 zo2」。hai2 zeon3 hang4 sik1 ge3 dung6 ci4 zi1 hau6，「so2」koeng4 diu6 go3 dung6 zok3 hai6 ji4 gaa1 faat3 sang1 gan2。
text: 當日文所（ところ）用喺文法上而唔係佢嘅詞彙意思嗰陣，佢可以好好噉傳達一個動作嘅狀態，例如，呢個字喺英文入面幾乎等同於「 about to 」，即係當用喺過去式動詞之後，佢嘅意思更加似「啱啱」，例如「我啱啱做完」。例如當講「做完之後，有啲嘢發生咗」。喺進行式嘅動詞之後，「所」強調個動作係宜家發生緊。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Bvalltu and I, in company with the increasing band of our fellow explorers, visited many worlds of many strange kinds. In some we spent only a few weeks of the local time; in others we remained for centuries, or skimmed from point to point of history as our interest dictated. Like a swarm of locusts we would descend upon a new-found world, each of us singling out a suitable host. After a period of observation, long or short, we would leave, to alight again, perhaps, on the same world in another of its ages; or to distribute our company among many worlds, far apart in time and in space.

jyutping: ngo5 tung4 Bvalltu hai2 ngo5 dei6 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 do1 ge3 taam3 him2 gaa1 tung4 bun6 ge3 pui4 bun6 haa6，caam1 gun1 zo2 hou2 do1 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 zung2 leoi6 ge3 sai3 gaai3。hai2 mau5 di1 dei6 fong1，ngo5 dei6 zi2 hai6 jung6 zo2 gei2 go3 sing1 kei4 ge3 dong1 dei6 si4 gaan3；zau6 hou2 ci5 jat1 kwan4 wong4 cung4 gam2，ngo5 dei6 wui5 gong3 lok6 hai2 jat1 go3 san1 faat3 jin6 ge3 sai3 gaai3，ngo5 dei6 mui5 go3 jan4 dou1 wui5 gaan2 ceot1 jat1 go3 sik1 hap6 ge3 zyu2 jan4。ging1 gwo3 jat1 dyun6 coeng4 si4 gaan3 ge3 gun1 caat3，mou4 leon6 hai6 coeng4 ding6 dyun2，ngo5 dei6 dou1 wui5 lei4 hoi1，zoi3 ci3 lok6 gei1，ho2 nang4 hai6，hai2 ling6 jat1 go3 si4 doi6 ge3 tung4 jat1 go3 sai3 gaai3；waak6 ze2 zoeng1 ngo5 dei6 ge3 gung1 si1 fan1 bou3 hai2 hou2 do1 si4 gaan3 tung4 hung1 gaan1 soeng6 soeng1 gaak3 hou2 jyun5 ge3 sai3 gaai3。
text: 我同 Bvalltu 喺我哋越嚟越多嘅探險家同伴嘅陪伴下，參觀咗好多好多唔同種類嘅世界。喺某啲地方，我哋只係用咗幾個星期嘅當地時間；就好似一群蝗蟲噉，我哋會降落喺一個新發現嘅世界，我哋每個人都會揀出一個適合嘅主人。經過一段長時間嘅觀察，無論係長定短，我哋都會離開，再次落機，可能係，喺另一個時代嘅同一個世界；或者將我哋嘅公司分佈喺好多時間同空間上相隔好遠嘅世界。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: I went later than usual, after noon, to the Lulu Island pizzeria on the greyish 23rd of March of 2022. At the cashier, in front of me, were handsome Mormon proselytizers, one thick and the other thin, ordering pizza. They had ties and eyeglasses on. Facing away, at the counter, the thinner one, still waiting for his order, sat to the left of the thicker one, already devouring his pizza. From his pizza, the thicker one handed the other a pineapple chunk, which he gulped. Metaphorically, they were like Lojban and Esperanto, or Animism and Buddhism, maybe. I ate two slices and drank a diet coke at my usual northwestern corner. A woman reminiscent of my mother came in to order. Maybe, my mother was like the pagan Earth Mother Goddess for some.

jyutping: ngo5 ci4 gwo3 ping4 si4，aan3 zau3 gwo3 hau6，hai2 2022 nin4 3 jyut6 23 hou6 ge3 fui1 sik1 dei6 daai3 heoi3 zo2 lou6 lou6 dou2 ge3 bok6 beng2 pou2。hai2 ngo5 cin4 min6 ge3 sau1 ngan2 cyu5，jau5 di1 leng3 zai2 ge3 mo1 mun4 gaau3 zyun2 gaau3 ze2，jat1 go3 hau5，jat1 go3 bok6，giu3 gan2 bok6 beng2。keoi5 dei6 daai3 zo2 ling5 daai2 tung4 ngaan5 geng2。min6 deoi3 min6，hai2 gwai6 toi2，go3 sau3 di1 ge3，zung6 dang2 gan2 keoi5 lok6 daan1，zo6 hai2 hau5 di1 ge3 zo2 bin6，ji5 ging1 tan1 gan2 keoi5 go3 bok6 beng2。hai2 keoi5 go3 bok6 beng2 jap6 min6，go3 hau5 di1 ge3 jat1 go3 dai6 zo2 jat1 faai3 bo1 lo4 bei2 ling6 jat1 go3，keoi5 tan1 zo2。bei2 jyu6 lai4 gong2，keoi5 dei6 ho2 nang4 hou2 ci5 lok3 gat1 baan1 tung4 sai3 gaai3 jyu5，waak6 ze2 hai6 maan6 mat6 jau5 ling4 leon6 tung4 fat6 gaau3。ngo5 hai2 ngo5 ping4 si4 ge3 sai1 bak1 gok3 sik6 zo2 loeng5 pin3 tung4 maai4 jam2 zo2 zi1 zit3 sik6 ho2 lok6。jau5 go3 ling6 jan4 lyun4 soeng2 dou3 ngo5 aa3 maa1 ge3 neoi5 jan2 jap6 lai4 lok6 daan1。ho2 nang4，ngo5 aa3 maa1 deoi3 mau5 di1 jan4 lai4 gong2 zau6 hou2 ci5 ji6 gaau3 ge3 dei6 kau4 mou5 can1 neoi5 san4 gam2。
text: 我遲過平時，晏晝過後，喺2022年3月23號嘅灰色地帶去咗露露島嘅薄餅舖。喺我前面嘅收銀處，有啲靚仔嘅摩門教轉教者，一個厚，一個薄，叫緊薄餅。佢哋戴咗領帶同眼鏡。面對面，喺櫃台，個瘦啲嘅，仲等緊佢落單，坐喺厚啲嘅左邊，已經吞緊佢個薄餅。喺佢個薄餅入面，個厚啲嘅一個遞咗一塊菠蘿畀另一個，佢吞咗。比喻嚟講，佢哋可能好似洛吉班同世界語，或者係萬物有靈論同佛教。我喺我平時嘅西北角食咗兩片同埋飲咗支節食可樂。有個令人聯想到我阿媽嘅女人入嚟落單。可能，我阿媽對某啲人嚟講就好似異教嘅地球母親女神噉。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: In the afternoon of the 29th of June of 2025, I ate Filipino purplish ube pancakes on the blue-sky sunny verandah. I walked to Tim Hortons café to enjoy an Earl Grey tea with oat milk and a Turkey Bacon Club Artisan Sandwich. There was a handsome Filipino mestizo with his family. There was an Eastern girl in an elegant white dress. There was a First Nations man. On my walk, I saw my ufologist Dane-French friend Michael in a hurry to get home, so that his ice cream in his knapsack wouldn't melt.

jyutping: hai2 2025 nin4 6 jyut6 29 hou6 ge3 haa6 zau3，ngo5 hai2 laam4 tin1 ge3 joeng4 gwong1 lou6 toi4 dou6 sik6 zo2 fei1 leot6 ban1 zi2 sik1 ge3 wu1 bui3 zin1 beng2。ngo5 haang4 heoi3 Tim Hortons gaa3 fe1 gun2，jam2 zo2 jat1 bui1 baak3 zoek3 caa4 pui3 jin3 mak6 naai5 tung4 maai4 jat1 go3 fo2 gai1 jin1 juk6 keoi1 lok6 bou6 sau2 gung1 saam1 man4 zi6。jau5 go3 leng3 zai2 fei1 leot6 ban1 wan6 hyut3 ji4 tung4 keoi5 uk1 kei2 jan4 hai2 maai4 jat1 cai4。jau5 go3 dung1 fong1 neoi5 zai2 zoek3 zyu6 gin6 jau1 ngaa5 ge3 baak6 sik1 kwan4。go2 dou6 jau5 go3 dai6 jat1 man4 zuk6 jan4。hai2 ngo5 haang4 gan2 ge3 si4 hau6，ngo5 gin3 dou2 ngo5 ge3 fei1 dip2 hok6 gaa1 daan1 mak6 faat3 gwok3 jan4 pang4 jau5 Michael gon2 zyu6 faan1 uk1 kei2，dang2 keoi5 bui3 nong4 jap6 min6 ge3 syut3 gou1 m4 hou2 jung4 faa3。
text: 喺2025年6月29號嘅下晝，我喺藍天嘅陽光露台度食咗菲律賓紫色嘅烏貝煎餅。我行去 Tim Hortons 咖啡館，飲咗一杯伯爵茶配燕麥奶同埋一個火雞煙肉俱樂部手工三文治。有個靚仔菲律賓混血兒同佢屋企人喺埋一齊。有個東方女仔着住件優雅嘅白色裙。嗰度有個第一民族人。喺我行緊嘅時候，我見到我嘅飛碟學家丹麥法國人朋友 Michael 趕住返屋企，等佢背囊入面嘅雪糕唔好融化。
